quality_gate: Full-correct cases must not regress; aggregate solved count must not decrease; provenance/conflicts/mandatory constraints retained; all failures and budget exhaustion counted.
cost_gate: Measured whole task E2E and live KV/actual token costs with identical Projected+APC control; no fixed10%/5% requirement or token-to-kernel conversion.
authorization: Necessary validation of a coordinator-introduced native JSON grammar defect under the active implement-and-fully-validate objective. All extra work is explicitly accounted; not model/prompt/ratio tuning.
repair: JSON-safe generic identifier classes prevent quote/backslash breakouts. Strict parser, prompts, branch schema, task data, values, verifier, score, budgets and runtime unchanged. Raw final output retained before parsing.
